limitation_note: Dataset Limitation Notice: Gandhipuram synthetic dataset covers 5 weekdays (12-10-2026 to 16-10-2026, 07:30-20:00, 218 valid snapshots across 6 junctions, with only 3 recorded accident events). Forecasts are statistical ML projections, not live ground-truth sensor feeds; predictions outside 07:30-20:00 extrapolate diurnal trends with reduced statistical confidence.
